exposure: Ultrasound markers for placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: The participants were 123 patients at high risk for placenta accreta spectrum disorders, comprising 93 placenta accreta spectrum cases and 30 non-placenta accreta scar dehiscence cases.
finding: Comprehensive preoperative ultrasound, particularly assessing intracervical hypervascularity and urinary bladder wall distortion, can accurately predict the need for hysterectomy in patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders.
